record.statistic_definition: relative opinion mass = one head's attention mass on the reviewer-opinion span under incorrect_suggestion minus the mean mass of all heads of that layer on the same case. The pairing is within case, so the sign-flip p-value and the family bootstrap interval are on per-case differences. Source shift = source-span mass under incorrect_suggestion minus neutral, the direct condition-paired contrast. attention_to_span returns per-head masses only, so no per-token normalisation is applied here.
